name: Developmental GO slim, fine (mouse)
description: A GO slim for developmental biology, fine depth: one folder per coarse term, holding its narrower terms (chondrocyte differentiation under skeletal, left/right pattern formation under pattern specification, the named pathways under signaling), each the GO term's annotated genes with descendants included. Sized for scoring cells. A folder may hold a term from elsewhere in GO when biology puts it there (osteoblast differentiation under skeletal). Built from GO releases/2026-07-26, mouse GAF 2026-01-05.
